reviews.detail: One set of four elemental stones is delivered to Man; one later Star Crumb/Star Dust set goes to Gladiator of the Stars. Repeated travel does not require a second elemental set; the stage-6 return is explicitly free. Stars sends the player back to Payon, while Man in comodo performs the final job change. Arrival job_star 29,32 is not asserted to be the Sun NPC's position.

Bare Payon/Comodo points do not establish map codes. The three Gladiators are dialogue NPCs without invented questions, kills, timers or skill prerequisites. Class TaeKwon Kid is retained without requiring all First Expanded alternatives.
